news.h: Ja'Marr Chase set to face off with Falcons
news.d: Ben Baby previews Ja'Marr Chase's mindset heading into the Bengals' Week 9 matchup with the Falcons.

news.h: Ja'Marr Chase's 'competitiveness' comes out at right time in Bengals' OT win
news.d: Visibly frustrated earlier in the game, Cincinnati Bengals star wide receiver Ja'Marr Chase cooled off in time to help his club to a 43-36 overtime victory over the Tennessee Titans on Sunday at Paycor Stadium.
